records: Binance Support's 2026-10-30 02:23 UTC incident update said deposits and withdrawals were temporarily suspended; a verified Binance News post later said deposits were normal and withdrawals paused, but its exact publication time and per-network scope were not exposed. Preserve the conflict until timestamped network-specific status is available.

Investing.com displayed an OKX XRP/USD quote at 03:41:35 UTC; it was over three hours old at the 07:09 UTC capture. Its separate daily-row last/high/low/volume fields have different or unclear cutoffs and volume denomination. Do not use as a current consolidated spot price.

TheXRPInvestor dashboard headline says 12 products while its categories (6 spot, 4 derivative, 1 index) sum to 11. Its universe mixes product types and is not comparable to spot-only ETF flow data until a product-level crosswalk is built.

CoinDesk's Binance 14 proof-of-reserves crosswalk concerns an Ethereum hot wallet and ETH customer backing. It does not identify the five compromised XRPL source wallets, the XRP-BF2 reserve address or an XRP-specific post-incident reserve shortfall.

TRM and Bitquery provide separate analytics of the same public XRPL transfer. Bitquery's no-outgoing observation ends at 03:54 UTC; subsequent disposition is unknown. A transfer to an attacker address is not proof of sale.
